data.name: Carroll
data.short_meaning: Wearing a freckled or speckled garment
data.long_meaning: The Old English name Carroll is derived from the Anglo-Saxon words 'carr' meaning 'deer' and 'hol' meaning 'valley' or 'clearing'. This name was given to individuals who lived in a deer-filled clearing. In some instances, it may be associated with the freckled or speckled clothing worn by certain monastic orders.
